name: You'll Be Back
source:
In this world full of real and present fears affecting too many others... Will you take a moment to indulge me a personal fear of mine?

I need to get this off my chest.

[From [url=https://dondonpatapon.itch.io/youll-be-back]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这个充满真实而现实的恐惧的世界里，影响着太多其他人……你能花点时间让我了解一下我个人的恐惧吗？

我需要把这件事说出来。

[来自[url=https://dondonpatapon.itch.io/youll-be-back]itch.io[/url]]
